deadline.value: The 2026/27 calendar says sciences doctorate applications run on a rolling basis until 16 April 2027, but it is tied to the 2026/27 year, not an autumn 2027 start, so no Fall 2027 deadline is stated.
deadline.quote: Les candidatures s’effectuent au fil de l'eau pour les premières années jusqu'au 16 avril 2027

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on the Sorbonne pages checked for this school.

supervisor.value: A doctorate application must be approved by the project leader (the future thesis director) and the director of the research unit, so a supervisor's agreement comes before admission.
supervisor.quote: A doctorate application must be approved by the project leader (the future thesis director) and the director of the research unit

also.quote: Obtain the agreement of a research supervisor to oversee your work.

funding.value: The page says about 50 new students a year are paid through contracts, but does not say what share of PhD students that is.

also.quote: At Sorbonne University, you need funding to enrol on a programme in the so-called ... (physics, chemistry, mathematics, etc.)
sans condition de nationalité ni d’université d’origine

entry_route.value: You need a master's degree or equivalent to be eligible for a doctorate, so a bachelor's alone is not enough.
entry_route.quote: To be eligible for a doctorate, you must hold a Master's degree or equivalent

notes: The page names CNES and ESO contracts specific to this school among the paid contracts.
